title: Mini Build: Test Report Runner
prompt: Write run_suite(cases) — cases is a list of (label, callable, expected). For each, call it with NO arguments, compare to expected, and RETURN a dict {"passed": n, "failed": m, "failures": [labels of failed cases in order]}.

tests.name: report computed
tests.code:
cases = [
    ("add ok", lambda: 2 + 2, 4),
    ("bad math", lambda: 2 + 2, 5),
    ("upper ok", lambda: "ok".upper(), "OK"),
]
r = run_suite(cases)
assert r == {"passed": 2, "failed": 1, "failures": ["bad math"]}, f"got {r}"
assert run_suite([]) == {"passed": 0, "failed": 0, "failures": []}, "empty suite"
tests.hint: loop, call the callable, compare, accumulate — failures keep their order.
